news.headline: TENX Initiates Coverage On Evercore ISI Group -- Rating Set to Outperform
news.summary: Evercore ISI initiated coverage of Tenax Therapeutics with an "Outperform" rating and a $39 price target, calling the upcoming Phase 3 LEVEL readout a "critical binary event" that could reshape market expectations given the large unmet need in PH-HFpEF.

news.headline: Tenax Therapeutics, Inc. Receives Consensus Recommendation of "Moderate Buy" from Analysts
news.summary: The seven analysts currently covering TENX give it a consensus "Moderate Buy" rating with an average 12-month price target around $38, following recent target hikes from Piper Sandler (to $50) and Guggenheim (to $40) ahead of the Phase 3 LEVEL data readout.

news.headline: Short Interest in Tenax Therapeutics (TENX) Increases by 132.9%
news.summary: Short interest in TENX jumped 132.9% to about 1.79 million shares (roughly 7.0% of float) as of June 30, 2026, up from 767,532 shares two weeks earlier, signaling a sharp rise in bearish or hedging positioning ahead of the binary Phase 3 LEVEL readout.

news.headline: FMR LLC (Fidelity) Discloses New 14.9% Stake in Tenax Therapeutics
news.summary: FMR LLC, the parent of Fidelity Management & Research, disclosed a new passive stake of 3,942,373 shares (14.9%) in Tenax Therapeutics as of June 30, 2026, one of the largest institutional accumulations disclosed ahead of the LEVEL trial readout.

news.headline: Tenax Therapeutics Announces Late-Breaking Presentation of LEVEL Clinical Trial Data at ESC Congress 2026
news.summary: Tenax will present Phase 3 LEVEL trial results for oral levosimendan (TNX-103) in a Late-Breaking Clinical Science session at ESC Congress 2026 in Munich on August 29, with topline data now expected in August 2026 ahead of database lock and statistical analysis.

news.headline: Tenax and Orion Secure Long-Term Levosimendan Supply Deal
news.summary: Tenax and Orion Corporation signed a Supply Agreement making Orion the primary manufacturer of the oral levosimendan product (initial 5-year term with automatic 3-year renewals), alongside a Sixth Amendment to their license agreement that extends the deadline for obtaining U.S. regulatory approval to December 31, 2035.

catalysts.label: Phase 3 LEVEL topline data readout
catalysts.detail: Tenax expects to report topline data from the registrational Phase 3 LEVEL trial of oral levosimendan (TNX-103) in PH-HFpEF in August 2026; enrollment (230+ patients) completed in March 2026 and the trial has since moved through database lock and statistical analysis.

catalysts.label: Late-breaking LEVEL data presentation at ESC Congress 2026
catalysts.detail: Full LEVEL trial results will be presented in a Late-Breaking Clinical Science session at the European Society of Cardiology Congress in Munich (Aug 28-31), presented by Prof. Sanjiv Shah, MD, Northwestern University, on Saturday Aug 29 at 11:15-11:30 CEST.

catalysts.label: LEVEL-2 global Phase 3 enrollment completion
catalysts.detail: The second registrational Phase 3 study (LEVEL-2, ~540 patients across 100+ sites in 15 countries) is expected to complete enrollment by the end of 2027.

catalysts.label: Q2 2026 financial results
catalysts.detail: Tenax's next quarterly earnings report and corporate update is estimated for mid-August 2026 by third-party earnings trackers (Q1 2026 results were released May 12), likely alongside or shortly after the LEVEL topline data disclosure; the company has not yet issued an official press release confirming the exact date.

pulse: As of July 25, 2026, Tenax Therapeutics remains in a quiet holding pattern ahead of the pivotal Phase 3 LEVEL readout for oral levosimendan (TNX-103) in PH-HFpEF, with topline data expected in August 2026 and a late-breaking full presentation confirmed for ESC Congress in Munich on August 29. The company shored up its manufacturing and IP runway on June 29 by signing a long-term supply agreement with Orion Corporation alongside a Sixth Amendment to their license extending the U.S. regulatory approval deadline to December 31, 2035, even as sell-side conviction keeps building into the catalyst: Evercore ISI initiated coverage (Outperform, $39 target) on July 22, joining a consensus "Moderate Buy" near $38 (Piper Sandler as high as $50, Guggenheim at $40). Institutional positioning has grown more crowded and two-sided, with Fidelity's FMR LLC disclosing a fresh 14.9% stake as of June 30 while short interest surged 132.9% to about 7% of float, leaving the stock's near-term trajectory hinging almost entirely on whether LEVEL hits its 6-minute-walk-distance primary endpoint.
